baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative أَيَحْسَبُ joins a mental estimate to the exhaustive negative لَّن ... أَحَدٌ around the relation عَلَيْهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A provisional supposition is inflated into universal immunity: the subject treats the absence of every possible effective controller as settled.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning as supposition supplies the insecure mental premise that the question exposes.
Capacity reaching effective control gives the denied predicate its force of mastery over the subject.
Exhaustive anyone under negation turns a local confidence into a claim of exception from every agent.

changed_reading.before: A neutral question asks whether another person is stronger than him.
changed_reading.after: The question diagnoses a fragile inner guess that has been overextended into total impunity from every effective agent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered roots ح س ب، ق د ر، ء ح د can be heard as count, measure, and one while remaining attached to يَحْسَبُ، يَقْدِرَ، and أَحَدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause forms a compact accounting chain: one who counts concludes that no single counter can measure his extent. The challenged error is not only overconfidence in force but the fantasy of being unassessable.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning opens a ledger-like rather than merely psychological register.
Measure reaching a thing's limit makes the denied act an assessment or delimitation of his extent.
One in counting supplies the smallest counter whose supposed inability is generalized.

changed_reading.before: He thinks no one can overpower him.
changed_reading.after: He calculates that no counter can measure, delimit, or close the account on him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb يَقْدِرَ is followed by عَلَيْهِ, a construction compatible with the root's branch of narrowing something to a scant measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The boast denies susceptibility to imposed limits: no one, he supposes, can narrow his room, means, or provision. Power and constriction remain live together.

activation_trace.role: Supposition marks unconstricted existence as his projection rather than an established condition.
Narrowing to a scant measure turns mastery over him into the capacity to restrict what is open or abundant.
Exhaustive negation makes him imagine that no possible source of constraint exists.

changed_reading.before: The issue is defeat by a stronger opponent.
changed_reading.after: The issue is his imagined exemption from every narrowing limit, including restriction of means.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The supposition verb carries neighboring branches of enoughness and counted social merit, while أَحَدٌ can isolate the individual challenger.
baseline_models.mechanism: He may be mentally converting sufficiency or social standing into a shield: what he counts as his worth is assumed to make every separate claimant ineffective.

activation_trace.role: Enoughness supplies the fantasy that his own resources remove dependence on anyone else.
Counted merits and social standing make prestige a possible mechanism of insulation.
Effective control names what his presumed status is imagined to block.
Individual-by-individual isolation pictures each possible challenger as too atomized to reach him.

changed_reading.before: He simply overestimates his bodily strength.
changed_reading.after: He mistakes accumulated means and counted standing for social immunity from every individual claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots in يَحْسَبُ and يَقْدِرَ also offer accountable supervision and deliberative arrangement without leaving the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denied power can be administrative or judicial: he imagines that nobody can inspect, order, and take his case in hand.

activation_trace.role: Supervision and practical accountability make reckoning an act performed upon conduct.
Arrangement by estimate and deliberation supplies the taking-in-hand of an affair.
Exhaustive anyone makes the imagined absence of an auditor or manager categorical.

changed_reading.before: No one can physically dominate him.
changed_reading.after: No one, he imagines, can investigate, administer, or bring his affair under accountable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Allotment, a bounded territory, and the undoing of a prohibition turn the focus limit into jurisdiction: the supposedly unreachable man is already situated inside divided space and changing legal states.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure is the focus-side possibility of being placed under a boundary.
Accountable supervision lets bounded space function as an administered domain.
Separating shares and dividing a thing supplies an ordered partition rather than limitless space.
A delimited place on earth locates the addressee inside a finite domain.
The repeated delimited place keeps that boundary active while the addressee's status is foregrounded.
The dissolution of a ban supplies a legal state whose limits can be imposed or removed.

structural_cues: 90:1-2 repeat the same البلد while shifting from oath framing to the addressee's condition within it.
The focus relation عَلَيْهِ can carry imposed authority or constraint alongside physical force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, bounded place, and release from prohibition; I infer that these make a jurisdiction capable of limiting him. A live alternative is that they frame location and sanctity without specifying an authority relation.

changed_reading.before: He denies that an opponent can overpower him.
changed_reading.after: He imagines that no authority can delimit him, although he is already inside apportioned, bounded, and norm-governed space.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation from another, creation by measure, and existence inside hardship make unlimited self-authorship impossible. The one who claims to be beyond measure is himself a measured outcome.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching an extent makes measurability the focus-side target of the boast.
Counting turns his claim into a calculation contradicted by his own measured origin.
Something arising from another supplies derivation and dependence rather than self-origin.
Creating as estimating and measuring directly cross-activates the focus branch of measured extent.
Hardship and struggle place the measured creature inside resistance he does not control.

structural_cues: Parent and offspring in 90:3 lead directly into the creation of the human in 90:4, immediately before the focus question.
The first-person plural creator in 90:4 contrasts with the singular human's claim of immunity in 90:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivation, measured creation, and hardship; I infer the irony that a measured creature claims no one can measure or limit him. The alternative keeps يقدر strictly at effective power while using creation only to identify the superior agent.

changed_reading.before: The human imagines that no external force can master him.
changed_reading.after: A generated and proportioned human imagines himself beyond the very measure and resistance that constitute his existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse supplies a spoken expenditure claim denominated in piled wealth. That claim turns the focus reckoning into a self-authored ledger whose spectacular outflow is being used as proof of immunity from audit.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting make the focus question capable of auditing the following boast.
Measured amount makes his claimed expenditure assessable rather than rhetorically boundless.
An uttered statement turns inward supposition into an externally inspectable boast.
Exhaustion and depletion give the boast the form of claimed resource outflow.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the stock from which the speaker claims to spend.
A mass piled layer upon layer makes abundance materially countable despite its boastful scale.

structural_cues: 90:6 immediately follows the focus with first-person reported speech and a quantified object of expenditure.
The movement from private يَحْسَبُ to public يَقُولُ externalizes the calculation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, depletion, wealth, and piled mass; I infer that the expenditure claim functions as a self-issued receipt meant to deter audit. It could alternatively be sheer bragging without a bookkeeping strategy.

changed_reading.before: He thinks nobody can defeat him.
changed_reading.after: He thinks his own account of immense spending is beyond measurement, verification, and accountable control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated frame substitutes seeing for having power. This creates an abductive chain in which presumed invisibility licenses presumed impunity: if no witness saw the act, he reasons, no agent can effectively act upon him.

activation_trace.role: Practical accountability supplies the enforcement function whose informational basis is tested by the parallel verse.
Capacity reaching effective control is re-read as enforceability rather than raw strength.
Exhaustive anyone establishes the universal absence of an enforcer that the speaker imagines.
The repeated supposition marks unseen action and untouchability as two linked beliefs.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the missing observation on which his theory of non-enforcement depends.
The same exhaustive anyone seals the syntactic parallel between absent controller and absent witness.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 share أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّـ... أَحَدٌ while the middle predicate changes from power to sight.
90:6, the boastful deed-report, stands between the paired questions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-identical frames and the sight predicate; I supply the arrow from observation to enforceable accountability. A live alternative is that power and sight are separate accusations intensified only by repetition.

changed_reading.before: He believes no agent has enough power to master him.
changed_reading.after: He believes an unseen act is unenforceable, so lack of a witness is converted into lack of anyone able to call him to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Made eyes, communicative organs, and manifest routes turn the subject's own body and orientation into evidence infrastructure. His capacity is granted, and the means of seeing, reporting, and choosing accompany him.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and testing information makes the focus supposition vulnerable to embodied evidence.
Effective capacity is revised from autonomous possession to an ability whose instruments were supplied.
Making and producing supplies the external origin of the faculties on which his agency depends.
The eye of care and supervision makes sight an organ of watchfulness as well as reception.
Conveying a message makes the tongue a channel by which hidden conduct can become report.
Speech passing from lip to lip supplies interpersonal transmission rather than sealed privacy.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies disclosed orientation and accountable choice.
Manifest appearance makes the two routes legible rather than hidden.

structural_cues: 90:8-10 enumerate paired organs and then paired paths after the question about being seen.
The repeated benefactive pronoun in the bodily endowment sequence identifies the same human as recipient rather than self-source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made faculties, communication, guidance, and manifest routes; I infer that they form evidence and agency infrastructure that defeats autonomous impunity. Alternatively, they may establish gratitude and choice without implying self-witness or report.

changed_reading.before: His power is an autonomous possession and secrecy protects its use.
changed_reading.after: His very capacity and the channels that can disclose its use are endowed, embodied, and oriented toward visible alternatives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question of who can act upon him is reversed into what he can bring himself to do. He projects power outward, yet the sequence tests capacity by a hard ascent and specifies its use as releasing another person from enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity is the focus hinge that can reverse from domination suffered to agency exercised.
Perilous difficulties of a route materialize the demanding action his claimed power does not perform.
The difficult rising obstacle gives capacity a resistant object rather than a victim.
Knowledge and discernment interrupt the speaker's self-sufficient estimate by requiring disclosed understanding.
Releasing a pledge or neck from enclosure redirects effective power toward liberation.
The neck makes the object of release a concrete embodied person under another's power.

structural_cues: The failed-action form in 90:11 follows the endowment of faculties and paths.
90:12 repeats the obstacle as a question, and 90:13 answers with an act that removes constraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hard passage, a knowledge challenge, and release from bondage; I infer a reversal from boasting about immunity to failing a test of liberating agency. The alternative is a simpler contrast between arrogance and a separately prescribed good deed.

changed_reading.before: Power means preventing anyone from acting over him.
changed_reading.after: Power is tested by whether he can cross resistance and use capacity to remove power from over someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding amid famine identifies isolated and abased persons whose need can bear upon accumulated wealth. The exhaustive 'anyone' becomes concrete: each vulnerable person can constitute a moral claim عَلَيْهِ, and meeting that claim narrows his surplus.

activation_trace.role: Practical accountability lets another person's need become an inspectable claim on conduct.
Narrowing provision gives the claimant's demand a real cost to the speaker's abundance.
Isolation individual by individual prepares the shift from abstract nobody to each socially isolated person.
Feeding another turns wealth into an outward transfer answering embodied need.
A day's severe event makes the obligation situationally urgent rather than abstract.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the bodily pressure exerted by unmet need.
A child cut off from a maintainer identifies a claimant whose dependence lacks its expected support.
Kinship makes the supposedly powerless individual's claim socially near and relationally specific.
The abasement of destitution supplies a person stripped of ordinary leverage yet still morally pressing.
Poverty as adhesion to dust locates the claimant at the material floor of the speaker's piled wealth.

structural_cues: The release-or-feeding alternatives in 90:13-16 convert the earlier wealth boast into named uses of resources.
The beneficiaries move from a related orphan to an abject poor person, widening the reach of أَحَدٌ while keeping each person concrete.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly aid, hunger, isolation, kinship, and poverty; I infer that these persons exert a moral due 'upon him' even without coercive strength. A live alternative is that the verses commend aid without making the beneficiaries grammatical claimants in 90:5.

changed_reading.before: No person is powerful enough to impose anything on him.
changed_reading.after: He supposes that not even one vulnerable person can have a binding claim upon him or reduce his hoarded surplus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Becoming part of a trusting group that exchanges counsel, bears responsibility, and practices mercy replaces the isolated sovereign self with reciprocal formation. Other people legitimately act upon him and are sustained by him.

activation_trace.role: Isolation and individual distribution expose the atomized social picture inside his claim of nobody over him.
Accountable management gives reciprocal counsel a focus-anchored alternative to unanswerable autonomy.
Sponsorship and standing over another supplies responsibility as a mode of belonging.
Settled trust supplies the relational security in which mutual influence need not be domination.
Exchanged counsel among a group directly supplies reciprocal action person upon person.
Bearing responsibility and remaining attached give mutual counsel durable social force.
Tender mercy directs reciprocal power toward care rather than mastery.

structural_cues: The reciprocal verb تَوَاصَوْا is repeated with patience and mercy as its two contents.
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ marks a transition from the singular boaster into membership among others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group membership, trust, reciprocal counsel, endurance, and mercy; I infer a social answer to the fantasy that nobody may act upon him. Alternatively, the group may describe shared virtues without directly reversing his authority claim.

changed_reading.before: Freedom means that no other individual can stand over or affect him.
changed_reading.after: Rightly formed agency includes chosen reciprocal answerability, where others counsel him and he bears responsibility for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social merit he may count for himself is displaced by mirrored companionship and right-left classification. Standing is not a private hoard that blocks every person; it emerges from response to visible signs and durable affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Counted merits and social honor supply the focus-side status that the closing classification reassigns.
Isolation by individuals contrasts with the later identity of companions belonging to a side.
Companionship and lasting association make standing a shared affiliation rather than solitary prestige.
Right as power and rightful claim reassigns effective standing to an oriented class.
Concealing truth explains how visible grounds of accountability can be actively screened off.
A manifest sign supplies the disclosed criterion that private self-reckoning refuses.
The repeated companionship branch creates a formally matched but opposed collective identity.
The left side supplies the opposed orientation by which the two companion groups are sorted.

structural_cues: 90:18-19 repeat أَصْحَابُ in parallel clauses while changing right to left.
The singular self-estimator of 90:5 ends within plural classes whose standing is relationally named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched affiliations, right-left orientation, concealment, and manifest signs; I infer that these replace self-counted prestige with externally legible standing. The alternative is eschatological grouping with no specific activation of social حسب.

changed_reading.before: His accumulated merit or status insulates him from every separate challenger.
changed_reading.after: His standing is not self-certified: response, affiliation, and orientation place him within a class that can be named and judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final image spatially reverses the denied relation. The man supposes no one can impose constriction عَلَيْهِ; the close presents fire and an emphatically shut enclosure عَلَيْهِمْ over a plural class.

activation_trace.role: Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the focus-side condition that he declares impossible.
Individual isolation is reversed when the supposedly untouchable singular is read toward an enclosed plural class.
Kindled fire supplies the enclosing medium that is now actually over them.
Closing and clamping over something makes the denied constriction spatially explicit.
The split root's second closure inventory reinforces a door sealed with deliberate firmness.

structural_cues: The prepositional relation shifts from عَلَيْهِ in 90:5 to عَلَيْهِمْ in 90:20.
The singular أَحَدٌ in the denied claim is answered by a plural pronominal group under enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, double-resolved closure imagery, and the repeated عَلَى relation; I infer that the final scene answers the earlier boast by literalizing imposed enclosure. The alternative treats the close as consequence without making it a deliberate lexical reversal of يقدر.

changed_reading.before: No one can ever close in upon him.
changed_reading.after: The relation he declares impossible returns at the close as a sealed condition over the class to which such self-reckoning leads.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cushion branch is nominal and remote from the ordinary verb يَحْسَبُ. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially activated by layered wealth; render it only as a metaphor for social insulation, never as the lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ح س ب contains a branch of cushioning and propping, while the denied power remains attached to عَلَيْهِ.

activation_trace.role: A cushion or prop supplies the material image of a self protected from pressure.
Effective control supplies the pressure that his imagined padding is meant to absorb.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material from which social insulation is built.
Matter felted layer over layer turns the wealth heap into figurative padding around the self.

changed_reading.before: His confidence is a purely mental error.
changed_reading.after: His piled wealth acts in his imagination like cushioning that props him up and absorbs every attempt to press power upon him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is highly form-distant: neither يَقْدِرَ nor نَجْعَل carries the cited utensil sense in the local syntax. It remains packet-anchored through the focus cooking-vessel branch and the later feeding emergency; downstream prose should mark it as an imagistic experiment about containment and portioning, not a proposed translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ق د ر includes the cooking vessel and its contents, allowing 'capacity' to flicker as a container with a measured yield.

activation_trace.role: The cooking pot supplies a bounded vessel in which abundance is subjected to measure and transformation.
The cloth used to lower a pot unexpectedly supplies the handling mechanism for the focus vessel image.
Feeding another gives the contained yield a social destination rather than leaving it hoarded.
Famine and exhausting hunger make portioning stored resources materially urgent.

changed_reading.before: No agent can overpower the speaker.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, he imagines himself and his abundance beyond anyone's power to place within measure, transform, and portion into nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The report-reading depends on the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the source root ر ء ي, so it must not replace the direct sense of seeing. It remains valid as a secondary abductive resonance because inquiry is anchored in the focus and public speech surrounds the sight question; render it as reportability supplementing eyewitnessing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch of seeking and testing information can connect effective control to discoverability even when direct sight is denied.

activation_trace.role: Seeking out and testing information supplies investigation as a route past presumed secrecy.
Effective control becomes reachable once information about the act can circulate.
Speech spreading among people supplies a public channel that the boaster cannot fully contain.
The non-dominant mapped branch of narrating reports turns sight into a secondary trace of tellability.

changed_reading.before: If no eye saw the act, no one can reach him.
changed_reading.after: Even absent an eyewitness, inquiry and circulating report can make the act discoverable and therefore answerable.

strongest_changes: The count-measure-one sequence changed brute invulnerability into a fantasy of being unmeasurable and unauditable.
The repeated 90:5 and 90:7 frames made presumed invisibility an abductive basis for presumed non-enforcement.
The obstacle, release, and feeding sequence reversed power from domination resisted into capacity used to remove constraint and answer vulnerable claims.
The final عَلَيْهِمْ with doubled closure imagery spatially answered the earlier denial that anything could be imposed عَلَيْهِ.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained genuinely polyphonic: supposition, accounting, enoughness, status, supervision, effective control, measured limit, constriction, exhaustive anyone, and isolated individuals formed several mechanisms. Context did not collapse them; it repeatedly converted private immunity into audit, boundedness, obligation, reciprocal formation, classification, and enclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: The strongest lexical fork remains whether يَقْدِرَ foregrounds effective mastery, measured delimitation, or constriction; the context sustains all three.
Reading vulnerable persons as claimants عَلَيْهِ requires a reader-supplied move from moral need to binding obligation, though the freeing and feeding sequence supports it.
The cushioning, cooking-vessel, and non-dominant report activations are controlled resonances only and should never displace the local verbal senses.
